## `genobi_scene`

3D scene document tools · read-only. Create, inspect or edit a 3D scene as data (primitives with material and role), add a rectangular room, read its room acoustics (RT60 per band, critical distance, pre-delay, nearest AKUSPACE preset) or a one-paragraph description. Start with examples/example for editable cathedral, house, exploded house, mountain, forest or city sets with a solo/pair neutral mannequin cast and optional surroundings; forest-companion adds one neutral animated pug. The models catalogue lists exact per-asset poses for set-characters edits. video-plan prepares an image-conditioned LTX + AKUSPACE graph, never a submission. Pure JSON transformation: no storage, no code, no paid call. Edits and rooms require the current revision. Save the returned document as a .json file for the person to Load scene in the 3D tab. The acoustics are a readout; nothing applies them to audio yet.

## `genobi_world`

Control and record the live World · writes. Pair with the open World tab using its one-use code. Send bounded character movement and camera controls together, record a live WebM session, or stop. Commands presets / load-preset {name} / takes read the scene library and load a preset into the scene (stops Play; refused in Walk); load-preset takes a preset's name or a move-library file name (fall-cathedral) and returns the loaded recipe. Command recipe returns the current recipe (at most 64 KB of JSON). Command send-to-project {take} does the library card's Send to Director for a take, by its id or name (the newest of that name): its first frame under Inspirations and the take as MP4 (with its WAV) under Project of the tab's open project, named after the take; it returns each assetId, no project link needed. Command capture {name} runs the Capture button's fixed-frame take from the current recipe (stops Play; refused in Walk, while recording live or while another take is being made): colour WebM, depth WebM and PNG when the renderer has depth, first frame, receipt and any loaded sound as WAV. Its result gives name, frames, width, height, fps, seconds and the files' local API paths; action download saves them. Every capture and live recording also lands in the tab's Takes library. No paid generation; files stay on the local server. Command submission returns an id; read result until done/error. Never resubmit a timed-out command; running may mean its result was lost. Model and FBX files must already be attached in the tab. Files are available through the returned local API paths to the paired session until the next capture or recording, disconnect or expiry.

- Tags: `3d`, `agents`, `mcp`
- Taught by: [`genobi-3d`](registry-skills.md#genobi-3d)
- Docs: [docs/world-live.md](world-live.md), [docs/world-builder.md](world-builder.md)

## `genobi_world_recipe`

Hand a World Builder recipe to the person's tab · writes. Put a World Builder scene recipe into the person's open World Builder on a linked project. action "send" with either take (falling-room: a named take; falling-room is the Cathedral, an orbit60 shot, idle then hit then fall, 145 frames, with a dry impact sound) or recipe (a full recipe as window.directorScene.getRecipe returns it; validated with the World Builder's own rules: 8k + 1 frames from 9 to 241, dimensions divisible by 64, at most 24 primitives and 64 KB). The tab applies it within a few seconds while World Builder is open, replacing the current set and camera; it does not capture. action "status" reads what happened: waiting, applied or refused with the tab's reason. Only the latest recipe is kept. Never resend a waiting recipe. To capture the applied recipe, pair with genobi_world and send its capture command. No paid generation.

- Tags: `3d`, `agents`, `mcp`
- Taught by: [`falling-room`](registry-skills.md#falling-room), [`genobi-3d`](registry-skills.md#genobi-3d)
- Docs: [docs/world-builder.md](world-builder.md), [docs/falling-room.md](falling-room.md)

## `genobi_arena`

Compare workflow results in Arena · writes. Compare two to four approaches (video or image) with prompts, observations and a preferred result. Link with the studio's one-use code first. Actions: list, create, read, update (revision + full draft), set_slot (change one approach by id: label, prompt, notes, model, workflow, guide, entry), add (copy studio media by sourceId: an upload, a finished run's job id or a catalogue clip; with slot it becomes that approach's result, without it a reference), upload (a local MP4/PNG/JPEG/WebP; slot optional), request_run (ask the person to run approaches). Run entries: ltx-2-5-fast, ltx-2-5-pro, flux-3-video, flux-3-image (takes the comparison's image references), flux-3-klein-api (BFL), and ltx-2-5-akuspace or flux-3-klein as workflows on the run location (Comfy Cloud or a free local ComfyUI). You never spend: request_run shows the person a Review and run banner that quotes and confirms; the runs then go out together and finished results attach to their approaches. Re-read after changes. A model label records intent, not availability. CLI: genobi arena --input JSON.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `workflows`
- Taught by: [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords)
- Docs: [docs/arena.md](arena.md)

## `genobi_submit`

Genobi submit · **paid**. Start a paid generation. This spends the person's money: call it only with a quoteId from genobi_quote whose price the person accepted, and exactly the quoted inputs. The idempotencyKey makes it safe to repeat: the same key and inputs replay the first run instead of paying again. It never retries; if the outcome is uncertain it says so, and you resubmit with the same key. Poll the job with genobi_job.

## `genobi_upscale_parts_plan`

Genobi split upscale plan · writes. Plan and price upscaling a video longer than one upscale takes (20 s), with the same inputs genobi_quote takes for generator "upscale" (sourceId, model "flux-3" or "seedvr2-upscale", upscaleFactor, optional upscaleCreativity and upscalePrompt) and, for SeedVR2 on a local ComfyUI, partSeconds. The clip is cut on frame boundaries into full 19 s parts plus the remainder (local ffmpeg, free; each cut is a source in this session), and every part is quoted: the answer is the plan, the combined price (the sum) and one quoteId covering the set. The same request again reopens its set instead of cutting twice. In a studio agent session the set becomes ONE step the person approves. Spends nothing.

Genobi Director feedback · read-only. Read the person's feedback on your last edit: what they changed in the Director since the revision your last command left (baseRevision), as Director commands in order, each with a label in frames and, with a beat grid, beats and bars ('title 変身 starts 12 frames (0.82 beats) later'); the open frame notes; and unmapped, the changes no command can express, each with its reason. ## `genobi_director_command`

Genobi Director command · writes. Apply one Director command to a project at the revision you read; the studio shows it live and can undo it. A stale revision is refused with the current one: read the project again and decide afresh. Frames are composition frames. Commands: add-clip {layerId (new), assetId, track (track id or new), startFrame, durationFrames, name?, sourceStartFrame? (in-point, source frames, audio and video only)}; add-graphic {layerId (new), moduleId, track, startFrame, durationFrames, name?, parameters? {name: value}} (a recipe from recipes or registryRecipes; parameters go over the settings of a layer already using it, and a recipe no layer uses needs every name in its required list, each checked against its type and range); move-clip {layerId, startFrame, track?}; trim-clip {layerId, startFrame, durationFrames}; split-clip {layerId, frame, newLayerId} (cut strictly inside the clip on a composition frame; keeps source samples, animation and track); duplicate-clip {layerId, newLayerId} (independent unlocked copy on a new lane at the top of the stack); remove-clip {layerId} (keeps media/provenance and detaches its review notes to their frames); set-muted {layerId, muted: boolean} (audio mute or visual hide); set-gain {layerId, gain} (audio only, 0 to 2). Split, remove and gain respect locks; copying and mute follow the UI's allowed operations on locked clips without unlocking or changing the original. New ids must not collide with any clip or track. set-placement {layerId, position? {x?, y?} (composition pixels from the centre, y down), scale? (0-10], opacity? [0,1], rotationDegrees? [-360,360], motion? {scaleTo?, xTo?, yTo?, opacityTo?} (the end it moves to linearly over the clip) or null} (video, image and graphics layers); set-parameters {layerId, parameters: {name: value}} (a graphics or filter recipe's declared parameters, text included; genobi_project lists each recipe's names, types and ranges); set-resolution {width, height} (whole pixels 16-4096 per side, width × height <= 1920 × 1080; presets 960×540, 1280×720, 1920×1080; rescales composition-pixel positions and motion offsets, preserving fitted zoom ratios and timing; for Match assets measure the largest video and fit the current aspect ratio within it and the pixel cap, using even dimensions); set-beat-grid {bpm? [20,300], beatOffsetSeconds? [0,3600] (where a downbeat falls, in seconds), beatsPerBar? (whole, 1-16)} (at least one; the others keep their value; a genobi_audio_analysis report's composition applies as is, once the person confirms the downbeat); set-prompt {text} (the earlier prompt brief); set-camera {shotId, camera: {shot-sizes, angles, movements}} (template projects); set-global-prompt {text} (the project's primary direction, up to 12000 characters; empty clears it); set-clip-prompt {layerId, text} (that clip only, up to 1200 characters; empty clears it); set-clip-directions {layerId, directions: {shot?, lens?, camera?, action?}} (each given field set, null clears it, others kept; shot: wide|aerial|medium|close-up|insert|low-angle|crane-wide|pass-by|heroic-medium; lens: 14mm|18mm|24mm|35mm|50mm|85mm|100mm|135mm|200mm (creative feel, not a model parameter); camera: {shot-sizes, angles, movements} as set-camera; action: forward|arc|zigzag|rise|accel|decel|converge|hold|drop|impact|infinity|release). Prompts and directions are separate fields: setting one never changes the other, and none of these quotes, submits or regenerates anything. A locked clip refuses them. set-preferences {preferences: {selection?: {family?: any|flux|ltx|h3|upscale, weights?: any|open-weights|commercial, execution?: any|local|cloud, agent?: any|hermes|claude|codex}, usage?: {purpose: demo|commercial-video|redistribute-source|resell-template, policy: any-licensed|open-source|mit-only}} or null}. Replaces explicit project preferences; null restores global defaults. Use when asked to remember project choices, not for a temporary session instruction. set-template-inputs {inputs: {subject?, title?, acoustic?}}; replace-plate {layerId, assetId}; add-note {noteId (new), frame, text (up to 500 characters), layerId?} (a note pinned to a frame and maybe a layer; author and createdAt are filled in); resolve-note {noteId, resolved? (default true; false reopens it)}; delete-note {noteId}.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `director`, `bundle`
- Taught by: [`anime-teaser`](registry-skills.md#anime-teaser), [`audio-visual`](registry-skills.md#audio-visual), [`character-piece`](registry-skills.md#character-piece), [`falling-room`](registry-skills.md#falling-room), [`genobi-director`](registry-skills.md#genobi-director), [`genobi-licensing`](registry-skills.md#genobi-licensing), [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords), [`product-video`](registry-skills.md#product-video)

Shared project context · read-only. Read bounded project decisions, open feedback, latest checkpoint, newer events and scoped reusable taste. ## `genobi_decision`

Record project evidence · writes. Append a bounded decision or interpretation with a stable id and current project/memory revisions. Reuse identical input on a lost response; conflicting reuse is refused. Agents must use source interpretation: never impersonate a human preference. Rerun and Undo alone never mean disliked style. Cite applied preferenceIds for provenance.

## `genobi_session_checkpoint`

Shared session checkpoint · writes. Start an external harness memory session (action start, sessionId, runner, goal), or save progress (action checkpoint with checkpoint). Built-in runners already have a sessionId in context. External checkpoints may include terminal status done/stopped/failed/waiting. Checkpoints cite real eventIds and their coveredCursor; stale or foreign checkpoints are refused. Never label interrupted work completed.

Unknown rights and uninspected content stay unknown; this is not Adapt as scene.

## `genobi_take_to_project`

Genobi take to project · writes. Hand a Ready take you made (id), or a video or audio result of your own media tools (sourceId: a trim, concat, crossfade or space), into the Director project you linked: the studio copies its clip, still, song or cut into that project as a production asset, at the revision you read, and the person sees it. A result's record names its operation and inputs, each input the project already holds as an input asset; hand the takes it was cut from in first so the project names them. A result built from media your session does not own is refused. Returns the assetId to place, for example with genobi_director_command replace-plate (a clip) or add-clip on an audio track (a song or audio cut). Never submits or pays; the same file twice answers with the same asset.

Genobi audio upload · writes. Bring a local WAV, FLAC or MP3 into this agent's Genobi session, for genobi_audio_analysis. filePath is an absolute path on this machine; the file is checked here (at most 50 MB and 20 minutes, a readable WAV, FLAC or MP3 header) and only its bytes are sent. Returns its sourceId; the same file again returns the same id. Stores a copy in the studio; never paid.

## `genobi_audio_analysis`

Genobi audio analysis · read-only. Analyse audio on the local studio: tempo and a fitted straight beat grid, a downbeat estimate the person should confirm, onsets per band (kick, snare, hat), an intensity curve and key moments (build-ups, crescendos, drops). beatFound is false, and grid and composition null, when no beat lands on an onset. `composition` holds bpm, beatOffsetSeconds and beatsPerBar to copy onto a Director composition. Name an audio source this session owns (sourceId, from genobi_audio_upload) or an audio asset of a linked project (copyId and assetId). librosa: true adds the optional librosa worker's view when the studio has it set up; otherwise the report says it was unavailable. Reads only; never paid.

Measure a video or audio source with ffprobe: duration in seconds, the video stream (width, height, fps, codec) and the audio stream (sampleRate, channels, codec), each present only when the file has it. Genobi media frames · writes. Extract still frames from a video at the given times (seconds from its start, each before its end; one to 16). Each frame is saved as a PNG image source in this session, in the order asked; returns their sourceIds and sizes. Local ffmpeg, never paid.

## `genobi_media_trim`

Genobi media trim · writes. Cut a section out of a video or audio source: duration seconds from start, inside the clip. A video cut comes back as an H.264 MP4 with the source's picture (rounded down to even sides) and its sound if any, at most two minutes; an audio cut as 16-bit WAV, at most twenty. Saved as a new source in this session; the source is unchanged. Local ffmpeg, never paid. genobi_take_to_project with its sourceId places the result in a linked Director project.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `dual-editor`
- Taught by: [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords)

## `genobi_media_concat`

Genobi media concat · writes. Join two to 8 clips end to end, in order: all video or all audio. Video is fitted to the first clip's even size and frame rate and keeps sound only when every clip has it; audio comes back as 48 kHz stereo WAV. The result is at most two minutes of video or twenty of audio. Saved as a new source in this session. Local ffmpeg, never paid. genobi_take_to_project with its sourceId places the result in a linked Director project.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `dual-editor`
- Taught by: [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords)
- Docs: [docs/dual-editor.md](dual-editor.md), [docs/architecture.md](architecture.md)

## `genobi_media_crossfade`

Genobi media crossfade · writes. Crossfade two clips of the same kind: the second fades in over the end of the first for duration seconds (0.1 to 5, shorter than either clip). Video is fitted to the first clip as concat does and keeps sound only when both clips have it. Saved as a new source in this session. Local ffmpeg, never paid. genobi_take_to_project with its sourceId places the result in a linked Director project.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `dual-editor`
- Taught by: [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords)
- Docs: [docs/dual-editor.md](dual-editor.md), [docs/architecture.md](architecture.md)

## `genobi_media_space`

Genobi media space · writes. Put an AKUSPACE room on a video or audio clip's existing sound, in one to 16 timed segments (start and end in seconds, in order, not overlapping, inside the clip). Rooms: small_room (0.67 s decay), empty_club (1.2 s decay), medium_room (1.9 s decay), cathedral (4.8 s decay); level low, mid (default) or high is the wet level, -25, -12 or 0 dB. The outdoor day and night presets (ambience) and dual_delay (a delay) are not available here; they exist only in the AKUSPACE LoRA. Each segment's tail rings past its end, up to the clip's end. snap "beat" or "bar" moves the edges to the composition grid (grid: bpm, beatOffsetSeconds, beatsPerBar, as genobi_audio_analysis reports composition; 120 BPM in 4 when left out). Video keeps its picture stream copied as it is and gains the treated sound; audio comes back as 48 kHz stereo WAV. Saved as a new source in this session; the source is unchanged. Local ffmpeg convolution, never paid. genobi_take_to_project with its sourceId places the result in a linked Director project.

- Tags: `agents`, `mcp`, `dual-editor`, `sound`
- Taught by: [`genobi-akuspace`](registry-skills.md#genobi-akuspace), [`genobi-swords`](registry-skills.md#genobi-swords)
- Docs: [docs/media-space.md](media-space.md), [docs/dual-editor.md](dual-editor.md), [docs/architecture.md](architecture.md)
